metadata.description: Tight-TP survival barrier label contract -- optimized for training signal yield. SL=2.0xATR(14), TP=1.25xATR(14), horizon=12 bars (M5=1hr). Empirically calibrated via scan_barrier_params.py on 352K XAUUSD M5 bars (2021-2026): 17.3% timeout, 52.3% TP, 30.4% SL, EV=+0.045 ATR. Replaces v1.0.0 (TP=3.5xATR) which produced 83% timeout -- a 4.8x improvement in trainable label yield.
metadata.author: cursor-agent
metadata.rationale: M5-level XAUUSD price action rarely sustains momentum beyond 1.25xATR within 1 hour. Wide TP (3.5xATR) resulted in 83% of trades expiring as timeout -- useless for supervised learning. Tightening TP to 1.25xATR captures frequent small moves while maintaining a 2.0xATR SL buffer. The 0.625:1 reward:risk ratio is compensated by a 63% conditional win rate (TP hit given resolution). Blind-entry EV is thin (+0.045 ATR ~ $0.15-0.25 pre-spread) -- the model must learn to select above-average entries to be net profitable after costs.
metadata.calibration_source: scripts/scan_barrier_params.py -- 352,541 M5 bars, 168 combos (SL=0.5-2.0, TP=0.75-3.0, H=6/12/24/48), 58K blind entries/combos
